description.value: Nu-Zone (V-Zone) Tactical Laser Tag is an indoor combat-simulation entertainment venue pioneered in 2016 as the first of its kind in Western Canada, using equipment originally developed for law enforcement and military tactical training. Its 15,000-square-foot facility features a 10,000-square-foot main battlefield with multi-level structures, plus electronic darts, billiards, and arcade machines. Private event bookings and public drop-in sessions are both available, making it a potential rainy-day destination for touring cyclists passing through Richmond.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at nu-zone.ca is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM address (111-4411 No.3 Road, Richmond, BC) and provides a phone number absent from OSM tags. The employment page references 'sale of refreshments,' suggesting some food/drink service, but no bike-specific amenities (racks, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site. OSM tags the place as a sports_centre with sport=laser_tag, which aligns with the website's combat-simulation laser tag entertainment business.
concerns: OSM name is 'V-Zone Tactical Laser Tag' but the legal entity is 'Nu-Zone Entertainment Ltd.' and the website brand is primarily 'Nu-Zone'; 'V-Zone' appears to be the game/product name — directory listing may benefit from clarifying the trade name.
OSM tags include no phone number; phone 604-370-3395 sourced from website only.
OSM address lacks unit number (111); website provides the complete address 111-4411 No.3 Road.
Cafe/food claim is ambiguous — only inferred from a staff duties description on the employment page, not confirmed by a dedicated menu or food service page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, actively operating indoor attraction in Richmond that could serve as a rainy-day or novelty stop for touring cyclists; none of the required criteria are confirmed, so the listing should note limited cyclist amenity evidence.
enrichment_extras.notes: The venue is multilingual (English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese), suggesting it caters to Richmond's diverse population. Reservations can be made online; drop-in is available for public sessions.

Café or food on site.detail: Employment page mentions 'sale of refreshments' as a staff duty, but no specific cafe, menu, or food offering is described on the website

wow_evidence: Indoor laser-tag venue ('first in Western Canada' self-claim discounted) — group-oriented family activity.
blurb: Tactical laser tag arena with arcade and billiards.
